The Vision

Load Bearing Pictures is defined by a commitment to bold, structural storytelling. We don’t just produce films; we architect narratives that endure. Our approach merges the grit of independent filmmaking with the precision of high-end production, ensuring that every frame we capture carries the weight of a powerful, well-crafted vision.

The Friendly Town

Wu Wei: After the Fall

Post-Production

After a severe head injury changes her relationship with movement, Canadian parkour pioneer Mandy Lam sets out to reclaim her body, her practice and her place in an art she has helped shape for decades. Learn more

The Hopping Vampires of Toronto

Pre-Development

When a Geung-si (an ancient hopping Chinese vampire) kidnaps her father, Wei, a young woman, along with a motley crew of friends, needs to rescue him before he becomes undead — along with the entire city.

The Team

Brennan Martin

Brennan Martin is a director, cinematographer, actor, and editor in Toronto, Canada. In his 15-year career in film, he’s made dozens of short films, a television show for Bell, has edited for TV5, Unis, TFO, among others, and acted in some of the most popular TV series in the world, including Outlander (Sony) and Fubar (Netflix). He’s now editing his feature debut, The Friendly Town.

IMDb

Mandy Lam

Born in Hong Kong, raised in Toronto, where she calls home, Mandy is a creative whose storytelling practice grew out of a long career in…Parkour! She has been practicing since 2007 and is one of the longest-practicing women in Canada. After a head injury interrupted her competitive trajectory, she began developing a short film based on that experience, ‘Wu Wei: After the Fall’.
